name: ironwallengraving-item-stock-queue
description: Worker queue for paid-order stock adjustment. The itemStock Lambda consumes messages from this queue and updates product stock plus the inventory ledger. This queue accepts payment-completed fanout messages and denies insecure non-TLS SQS requests.

producers.name: payment-completed fanout
producers.description: Receives paid-order events from the payment-completed fanout path.

producers.name: orderSideEffectRecovery
producers.description: Manual DR order recovery can requeue missing stock-adjustment work.

dead_letter_queue.name: ironwallengraving-item-stock-queue-dlq
dead_letter_queue.description: DLQ for item stock messages that fail processing after 5 receives.

name: ironwallengraving-storefront-html-renderer-queue
description: Worker queue for publish-time storefront HTML regeneration. The storefrontHtmlRenderer Lambda consumes messages from this queue, writes prerendered site objects, and invalidates CloudFront.
